Hi Priya — thanks for the note. Looping in Monica (HR Ops) and Lauren (Security Ops) who own the artifacts you asked for. Quick answers before we assemble the bundle:  

- Training roster: we can export completion timestamps for any training cohort as CSV; retention is 7 years for training audit logs.  
- Background checks: we store redacted copies for personnel who have undergone checks; full PII resides in our vendor background check provider (third party). We will provide redacted PDFs and a short attestation from HR.  
- Deprovisioning matrix: we keep an access deprovision matrix in Confluence and an exported XLSX that shows role->access->SLA. Average SLA for removal is 4 business days for routine leavers, 2 business days for high-risk roles; emergency deprovisioning can be same-day.

Monica — can you prep the redacted BG PDFs and the training CSV? Lauren — can you export the access_deprovision_matrix.xlsx and a short note about automation/fallbacks?

I will aggregate into a Drive folder and share a single link. If you prefer DocuSign evidence or signed attestations, tell us and we’ll add it.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Manager, Account Success — Redwood Inference
